# Isaiah Chapter 61 -- The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

## Consensus Translation

*[Full consensus translation of all 11 verses]*

*Anointed to proclaim; liberty to captives; year of favor; oaks of righteousness; garment of praise*

---

## SOPHIA's Council Notes

Isaiah chapter 61 (The Year of the LORD's Favor) addresses anointed to proclaim; liberty to captives; year of favor; oaks of righteousness; garment of praise. The key verse — "The Spirit of the Lord GOD is upon me, because the LORD has anointed me to bring good news to the poor" — captures the chapter's central message. This chapter belongs to Third Isaiah (chs. 56-66), focused on the restored community and eschatological hope.
